reviewConclusions: The immutable original 0.32 numerical baseline and fixed B native artifact are labeled separately; only the three exact configuration arms and sixteen-reader subset are admitted.

The native v2 binding helper is unchanged. It verifies actual core/owner/engine/adapter/source identities against the original B sourceRoot and c3 tracked-source attestation, while the common harness has separate actual fingerprints.

The readCell implementation, query, independent correction oracle, seed batches and writer loop are unchanged. Full-call timing starts before the C2 FIFO wrapper and includes its queue wait and complete public decoding.

FIFO admission subtracts queue wait from the remaining public timeout, propagates aborts and releases a slot on either fulfillment or rejection; completed cells require no active/queued/rejected calls.

Native reader acquisition uses FIFO shift/push. Even with only three admitted calls, the pool can rotate across all sixteen independent connections; the new observer checks distinct actual port identities and separately caps active control scopes.
The physical observer counts public native-port control scopes including first/warmup/final calls, not simultaneous native execution tasks. Its scope label is accurate and shared by all three arms.

Small100k timings are explicitly unqualified; large sixteen-reader screens use the original eight absolute limits and retain drift, source, receipt, exact-answer, lifecycle and cleanup checks. A winner still needs one-reader and fresh/reversed control qualification.
